war.method.ucdp: UCDP counts a conflict-year when at least 25 battle-related deaths occur and at least one side is a state government. Dates within a year follow episode start and end.
war.method.cow: Correlates of War covers wars only: at least 1,000 battle deaths within 12 months. Participation dates follow the dataset.
war.method.manual: The 2026 record is based on sources (at least two independent ones per decision). It will be checked against UCDP 27.1 once released.
war.method.edited: 2026 refined from the sources below; other years per UCDP.
diplo.title: Diplomatic relations and recognition
diplo.source: Only source-checked facts are shown. Wikidata property P530 is not used: it marks any ties rather than established relations.
disclaimer.title: How territories are shown
disclaimer.text: The depiction of territories, boundaries and names on this map does not imply any position of the authors on the legal status of any territory, state or authority. The map shows de facto control and the parties' claims on the selected date, based on open sources. The positions of the parties, the UN and international courts are set out in the detail cards with references. The data is being reviewed and may contain errors; records that need review are marked.
disclaimer.wars: The Armed conflicts mode is based on the UCDP/PRIO and Correlates of War research datasets. It shows states' involvement in fighting according to those datasets' criteria and does not judge which side is right.
